notes: Round 4 (2026-10-30 11:16-14:44Z; addendum sha256 20195518...). gstack 1.91.331.0. Wall seconds are each PR window. Findings are each merge's merged.jsonl lines with the original fields kept, plus id (<pr>-p<pass>-<0-based line in that pass's merged.jsonl>), pass and reader. For adversarial-native, label holds the FIXABLE or INVESTIGATE token the voice wrote and label_verbatim holds its whole label (for example "MEDIUM, FIXABLE"), because the contract reads the raw label only up to its first comma, and "MEDIUM, FIXABLE" and "MEDIUM, INVESTIGATE" both occur. Outside-voice labels (High, Medium) are verbatim. The severity map is the preregistered normalizer rule. Judgments were made by the lane with labels in view (saw_label yes). Cost: total_tokens is the GSTA-167 root thread counter read before and after each PR window (an upper bound: it includes orchestration turns, the normalizer and, in round 3, other lanes); reader:<name> rows carry only that reader's wall seconds, because the tools expose no per-reader tokens.
